info.title: TradeLedger API
info.description:
JSON API for the TradeLedger trading journal.

**Authentication:** every endpoint except this document needs a personal API token, created on the Account page of the website: `Authorization: Bearer tl_...`. Tokens expire (90 days by default) and can be revoked; session cookies are ignored. Each token sees and changes only its owner's records; another user's record answers 404.

**Conventions:** decimal values are exact strings; timestamps are UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`; unavailable values are `null`; money is per quote currency; R values are currency-neutral; cumulative R is not account equity. Unknown body fields and query parameters are rejected with 400.

get.description: Public: needs no token, and is available even when the API is switched off.

quote_currency.description: Currency of all money values for this trade.

closed_at.description: Exit time. null for OPEN trades, and for legacy CLOSED trades recorded before the exit time was captured (never invented). UTC, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-02T08:15:00Z.

entry_price.description: Entry price. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

stop_loss.description: Initial stop-loss price. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

take_profit.description: Target price, if planned. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

exit_price.description: Exit price. null while OPEN. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

position_size.description: Position size in the units the instrument's contract_multiplier assumes. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

fees.description: Total fees, in the quote currency. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

created_at.description: When the record was created. UTC, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-02T08:15:00Z.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed. UTC, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-02T08:15:00Z.

result.description: Calculated by the analytics engine for CLOSED trades; null for OPEN trades.

outcome.description: From net P&L: > 0 WIN, < 0 LOSS, exactly 0 BREAKEVEN.

gross_pnl.description: (exit - entry) x direction x size x contract_multiplier. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

fees.description: Fees. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

net_pnl.description: gross_pnl - fees. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

initial_risk.description: Money lost if the stop is hit (fees excluded). null if the stop is invalid. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

realised_r.description: net_pnl / initial_risk. null when initial risk is not positive. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

planned_rr.description: Planned reward / planned risk from prices. null without a valid target. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

r_unavailable_reason.description: Why realised_r is null, if it is.

trade_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time. A value without an offset is treated as UTC; offsets are converted to UTC. A bare date is rejected.

closed_at.description: Exit time. Required when the trade is CLOSED; must be null/absent when OPEN; must not be before trade_date. Exception: a legacy CLOSED trade whose exit time was never recorded may keep null when replaced with PUT.

status.description: OPEN or CLOSED (case-insensitive). If omitted: CLOSED when exit_price is given, otherwise OPEN. CLOSED requires exit_price; OPEN must not have one.

entry_price.description: Greater than 0. Decimal value. Send a string (recommended, e.g. "1.085") or a JSON number; numbers are read exactly, never as binary floats. NaN and Infinity are rejected. At most 15 significant digits, 15 digits before the decimal point and 15 decimal places.

stop_loss.description: Greater than 0. LONG: below entry. SHORT: above entry. Never equal to entry.

take_profit.description: Optional. LONG: above entry. SHORT: below entry.

exit_price.description: Required for CLOSED, absent/null for OPEN. Greater than 0.

trade_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time. A value without an offset is treated as UTC; offsets are converted to UTC. A bare date is rejected.

closed_at.description: Exit time. Required when the trade is CLOSED; must be null/absent when OPEN; must not be before trade_date. Exception: a legacy CLOSED trade whose exit time was never recorded may keep null when replaced with PUT.

status.description: OPEN or CLOSED (case-insensitive). If omitted: CLOSED when exit_price is given, otherwise OPEN. CLOSED requires exit_price; OPEN must not have one.

entry_price.description: Greater than 0. Decimal value. Send a string (recommended, e.g. "1.085") or a JSON number; numbers are read exactly, never as binary floats. NaN and Infinity are rejected. At most 15 significant digits, 15 digits before the decimal point and 15 decimal places.

stop_loss.description: Greater than 0. LONG: below entry. SHORT: above entry. Never equal to entry.

take_profit.description: Optional. LONG: above entry. SHORT: below entry.

exit_price.description: Required for CLOSED, absent/null for OPEN. Greater than 0.

symbol.description: Unique, upper case, 1-20 letters, digits or underscores.

price_increment.description: Smallest price step quoted, e.g. 0.00001. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

contract_multiplier.description: Money (in quote_currency) per 1.0 move in price per 1.0 unit of position_size. Depends on your broker's contract specification; sample instruments use illustrative values. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

quote_currency.description: 3-letter currency code in which P&L is denominated.

created_at.description: When the record was created. UTC, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-02T08:15:00Z.

symbol.description: 1-20 letters, digits or underscores; stored upper case.

asset_class.description: FOREX, COMMODITY, INDEX, STOCK or OTHER (case-insensitive).

value.description: The value that ranked this trade (R or net P&L). Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

amount.description: Largest fall from a running peak (>= 0), in R or in one currency. Never a percentage. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

trough_trade_id.description: null when there was no drawdown.

gross_pnl.description: Sum of P&L before fees. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

fees.description: Sum of fees. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

net_pnl.description: Sum of P&L after fees. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

winning_pnl.description: Sum of net P&L of winning trades (>= 0). Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

losing_pnl.description: Sum of net P&L of losing trades (<= 0). Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

profit_factor.description: winning_pnl / |losing_pnl|. null with no losing trades. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

win_rate.description: wins / trades, as a fraction 0-1. null with no trades. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

loss_rate.description: losses / trades, 0-1. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

breakeven_rate.description: breakevens / trades, 0-1. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

r_trades.description: Trades with a usable realised R.

total_r.description: Sum of realised R. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

average_r.description: Mean realised R. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

average_win_r.description: Mean R of winning trades. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

average_loss_r.description: Mean R of losing trades (negative). Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

expectancy_r.description: P(win) x average_win_r + P(loss) x average_loss_r, in R per trade. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

profit_factor_r.description: Sum of positive R / |sum of negative R|. null with no losses. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

average_planned_rr.description: Mean planned R:R of trades with a valid target. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

money.description: One entry per quote currency. Currencies are never added together.

win_rate.description: wins / trades, as a fraction 0-1. null with no trades. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

loss_rate.description: losses / trades, 0-1. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

breakeven_rate.description: breakevens / trades, 0-1. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

average_planned_rr.description: Mean planned R:R of trades with a valid target. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

money.description: One entry per quote currency. Currencies are never added together.

realised_at.description: Exit time, or entry time for legacy trades with no recorded exit. UTC, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-02T08:15:00Z.

realised_r.description: This trade's realised R. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

cumulative_r.description: Running total of realised R. NOT account equity. Exact decimal as a string (never a float).

open_trades.description: Counted, but excluded from realised metrics.

excluded.description: Closed trades that could not be evaluated, with reasons.

r_unavailable.description: Closed trades counted, but with no realised R.

unknown_close_time_trade_ids.description: Legacy trades ordered by entry time.

details.description: Field name -> problem. Present only when useful.

bearerAuth.description: Personal API token (starts with tl_). Create and revoke tokens on /account.
